reference: Mi-24D: tandem cockpit; pilot steam panel with the SPO-10 Sirena-3M RWR, centre cyclic, collective and two engine levers on the left, PKV collimator sight on the coaming; operator: basic flight instruments around the KPS-53AV stabilised gun sight with the Raduga-F guidance periscope and its handle unit, basic flight controls. Sources: 16va.be 'Combat Hinds' (https://www.16va.be/4.2_les_mi-24_part1_eng.html), airvectors.net (https://airvectors.net/avhind_1.html), Chuck's DCS Mi-24P guide (https://chucksguides.com/aircraft/dcs/mi-24p/) for the turquoise panel layout
